eligibility: Graduates from Sub-Saharan African countries with a bachelor's degree (at least Second Class Upper or equivalent, completed within the last 6 years); this award is tied to the MSc in Water and Environmental Engineering at 2iE.

title: DAAD In-Country/In-Region Scholarship — MSc Water & Environmental Engineering (2iE)

eligibility: Young climate leaders aged 20-30 already active in climate policy, advocacy or entrepreneurship, with a specific initiative (policy proposal, campaign or venture); good command of English; available for the online phase (Dec 2026-Feb 2027) and the Brussels week (28 Feb-6 Mar 2027). title: CEPS / Heinrich Böll Stiftung Climate Leadership Programme 2027
Integrated Water Resources Management (IWRM) for Climate Resilience, 2026 Edition

A certificate from the course organisers is awarded on completion. Enrolment closes 15 November 2026.

Certificate after completing all assignments.
